verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיִקְחוּ־ לִ֖י תְּרוּמָ֑ה מֵאֵ֤ת כָּל־ אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדְּבֶ֣נּוּ לִבּ֔וֹ תִּקְח֖וּ אֶת־ תְּרוּמָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·yiq·ḥū- lî tə·rū·māh mê·’êṯ kāl- ’îš ’ă·šer yid·də·ḇen·nū lib·bōw tiq·ḥū ’eṯ- tə·rū·mā·ṯî
verses.literal: Tell the Israelites . . . to bring Me an offering . . . You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel que me tragam uma oferta; de todo homem cujo coração o impelir a isso, dele tomareis a minha oferta.

verses.original: וְזֹאת֙ הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּקְח֖וּ מֵאִתָּ֑ם זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ hat·tə·rū·māh ’ă·šer tiq·ḥū mê·’it·tām zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: This is the offering you are to accept from them gold silver and bronze
verses.literalPt: Esta é a oferta que deles tomareis: ouro, prata, cobre,

verses.original: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš wə·‘iz·zîm
verses.literal: blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . fine linen and goat hair
verses.literalPt: estofo azul, púrpura, escarlata, linho fino, pelos de cabras,

verses.original: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·rōṯ ’ê·lim mə·’ād·dā·mîm wə·‘ō·rōṯ tə·ḥā·šîm wa·‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm
verses.literal: ram skins dyed red and fine leather acacia wood
verses.literalPt: peles de carneiros tintas de vermelho, peles de animais marinhos, madeira de acácia,

verses.original: שֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּאֹ֑ר בְּשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: še·men lam·mā·’ōr bə·śā·mîm lə·še·men ham·miš·ḥāh wə·liq·ṭō·reṯ has·sam·mîm
verses.literal: olive oil for the light spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense
verses.literalPt: azeite para a luz, especiarias para o óleo de unção e para o incenso aromático,

verses.original: אַבְנֵי־ שֹׁ֕הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפֹ֖ד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·nê- šō·ham wə·’aḇ·nê mil·lu·’îm lā·’ê·p̄ōḏ wə·la·ḥō·šen
verses.literal: and onyx stones . . . and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece
verses.literalPt: pedras de ônix e pedras de engaste para o éfode e para o peitoral.

verses.original: וְעָ֥שׂוּ לִ֖י מִקְדָּ֑שׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śū lî miq·dāš wə·šā·ḵan·tî bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me so that I may dwell among them
verses.literalPt: Far-me-ão um santuário para que eu habite no meio deles.

verses.original: כְּכֹ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתְךָ֔ אֵ֚ת תַּבְנִ֣ית הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת תַּבְנִ֣ית כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וְכֵ֖ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mar·’eh ’ō·wṯ·ḵā ’êṯ taḇ·nîṯ ham·miš·kān wə·’êṯ taḇ·nîṯ kāl- kê·lāw wə·ḵên ta·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings . . . according to the pattern I show you
verses.literalPt: Seguindo em tudo o que eu te mostrar, o modelo do tabernáculo e o modelo de todos os seus móveis, assim mesmo o farás.

verses.original: וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֲר֖וֹן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֙צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śū ’ă·rō·wn ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm ’am·mā·ṯa·yim wā·ḥê·ṣî ’ā·rə·kōw wə·’am·māh wā·ḥê·ṣî rā·ḥə·bōw wə·’am·māh wā·ḥê·ṣî qō·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood two and a half cubits long a cubit and a half wide and a cubit and a half high
verses.literalPt: Farão uma arca de madeira de acácia; de dois cúbitos e meio será o seu comprimento, de um cúbito e meio a sua largura e de um cúbito e meio a sua altura.

verses.original: וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתוֹ֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ תְּצַפֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עָלָ֛יו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’ō·ṯōw zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr mib·ba·yiṯ ū·mi·ḥūṣ tə·ṣap·pen·nū wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘ā·lāw zêr zā·hāḇ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out and make . . . a gold molding around it
verses.literalPt: Cobri-la-ás de ouro puro; por dentro e por fora, a cobrirás e farás sobre ela uma bordadura de ouro.

verses.original: וְיָצַ֣קְתָּ לּ֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל־ צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־ צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣaq·tā lōw ’ar·ba‘ ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ zā·hāḇ wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ‘al ’ar·ba‘ pa·‘ă·mō·ṯāw ū·šə·tê ṭab·bā·‘ōṯ ‘al- ṣal·‘ōw hā·’e·ḥāṯ ū·šə·tê ṭab·bā·‘ōṯ ‘al- ṣal·‘ōw haš·šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet two rings on one side and two on the other
verses.literalPt: Fundirás para ela quatro argolas de ouro, que porás nos quatro cantos da arca; haverá duas argolas num lado dela, e duas, noutro.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בַדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḇad·dê ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’ō·ṯām zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: And make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold
verses.literalPt: Farás também varais de madeira de acácia e os cobrirás de ouro.

verses.original: וְהֵֽבֵאתָ֤ אֶת־ הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֥את אֶת־ הָאָרֹ֖ן בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ’eṯ- hab·bad·dîm baṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ōṯ ‘al ṣal·‘ōṯ hā·’ā·rōn lā·śêṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·rōn bā·hem
verses.literal: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark in order to carry it
verses.literalPt: Meterás os varais nas argolas aos lados da arca, para com eles se levar a arca.

verses.original: בְּטַבְּעֹת֙ הָאָרֹ֔ן יִהְי֖וּ הַבַּדִּ֑ים לֹ֥א יָסֻ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ hā·’ā·rōn yih·yū hab·bad·dîm lō yā·su·rū mim·men·nū
verses.literal: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark they must not be removed
verses.literalPt: Os varais ficarão nas argolas da arca; dela não serão removidos.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֖ אֶל־ הָאָרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָעֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’el- hā·’ā·rōn ’êṯ hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ ’ă·šer ’et·tên ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: And place inside the ark the Testimony which I will give you
verses.literalPt: Porás na arca o Testemunho, que te hei de dar.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ כַפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֙צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḵap·pō·reṯ zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr ’am·mā·ṯa·yim wā·ḥê·ṣî ’ā·rə·kāh wə·’am·māh wā·ḥê·ṣî rā·ḥə·bāh
verses.literal: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide
verses.literalPt: Farás também um propiciatório de ouro puro; de dois cúbitos e meio será o seu comprimento, e de um cúbito e meio, a sua largura.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ שְׁנַ֥יִם כְּרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā šə·na·yim kə·ru·ḇîm zā·hāḇ miq·šāh ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām miš·šə·nê qə·ṣō·wṯ hak·kap·pō·reṯ
verses.literal: Make two cherubim - of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat
verses.literalPt: Farás dois querubins de ouro; de ouro batido os farás, nas duas extremidades do propiciatório.

verses.original: וַ֠עֲשֵׂה כְּר֨וּב אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב־ אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן־ הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֶת־ הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עַל־ שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śêh kə·rūḇ ’e·ḥāḏ miq·qā·ṣāh miz·zeh ū·ḵə·rūḇ- ’e·ḥāḏ miq·qā·ṣāh miz·zeh min- hak·kap·pō·reṯ ta·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- hak·kə·ru·ḇîm ‘al- šə·nê qə·ṣō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: one cherub on one end and one - on the other all made - from one piece of gold
verses.literalPt: Farás um querubim numa extremidade e outro querubim, noutra extremidade; de uma só peça com o propiciatório fareis os dois querubins nas duas extremidades dele.

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־ הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִ֑יו אֶל־ הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת יִהְי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū hak·kə·ru·ḇîm pō·rə·śê ḵə·nā·p̄a·yim lə·ma‘·lāh sō·ḵə·ḵîm bə·ḵan·p̄ê·hem ‘al- hak·kap·pō·reṯ ū·p̄ə·nê·hem ’îš ’el- ’ā·ḥîw ’el- hak·kap·pō·reṯ yih·yū pə·nê hak·kə·ru·ḇîm
verses.literal: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward overshadowing the mercy seat - The cherubim are to face each other . . . - looking toward the mercy seat
verses.literalPt: Os querubins estenderão as suas asas por cima do propiciatório, cobrindo-o com as asas e tendo as faces voltadas uma a outra; as faces dos querubins olharão para o propiciatório.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֧ אֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־ הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶל־ הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־ הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’eṯ- hak·kap·pō·reṯ ‘al- hā·’ā·rōn mil·mā·‘ə·lāh wə·’el- hā·’ā·rōn tit·tên ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ ’ă·šer ’et·tên ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Set the mercy seat atop . . . the ark and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark
verses.literalPt: Porás o propiciatório em cima da arca; e dentro da arca porás o Testemunho, que te hei de dar.

verses.original: וְנוֹעַדְתִּ֣י לְךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְדִבַּרְתִּ֨י אִתְּךָ֜ מֵעַ֣ל הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת מִבֵּין֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֲצַוֶּ֛ה אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·w·‘aḏ·tî lə·ḵā šām wə·ḏib·bar·tî ’it·tə·ḵā mê·‘al hak·kap·pō·reṯ mib·bên šə·nê hak·kə·ru·ḇîm ’ă·šer ‘al- ’ă·rōn hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·ṣaw·weh ’ō·wṯ·ḵā ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Ali, virei a ti e de sobre o propiciatório, do meio dos querubins que estão sobre a arca do Testemunho, falarei contigo a respeito de todas as coisas que eu te ordenar com relação aos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ שֻׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā šul·ḥān ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm ’am·mā·ṯa·yim ’ā·rə·kōw wə·’am·māh rā·ḥə·bōw wə·’am·māh wā·ḥê·ṣî qō·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high
verses.literalPt: Farás também uma mesa de madeira de acácia; de dois cúbitos será o seu comprimento, de um cúbito, a sua largura, e de um cúbito e meio, a sua altura.

verses.original: וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’ō·ṯōw zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lōw zêr zā·hāḇ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it
verses.literalPt: Cobri-la-ás de ouro puro, e far-lhe-ás uma bordadura de ouro.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ לּ֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ זֵר־ זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lōw mis·ge·reṯ ṭō·p̄aḥ sā·ḇîḇ wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā zêr- zā·hāḇ lə·mis·gar·tōw sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim
verses.literalPt: Também lhe farás um rebordo da largura duma mão, ao redor do qual farás uma bordadura de ouro.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lōw ’ar·ba‘ ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ zā·hāḇ wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’eṯ- haṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ōṯ ‘al ’ar·ba‘ hap·pê·’ōṯ ’ă·šer lə·’ar·ba‘ raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners at its four legs
verses.literalPt: Também lhe farás quatro argolas de ouro e meterás as argolas nos quatro cantos que estão sobre os seus quatro pés.

verses.original: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘um·maṯ ham·mis·ge·reṯ tih·ye·nā haṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ōṯ lə·ḇāt·tîm lə·ḇad·dîm lā·śêṯ ’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān
verses.literal: The rings are to be close to the rim to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table
verses.literalPt: Perto do rebordo estarão as argolas, nas quais se meterão os varais para se levar a mesa.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־ הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְנִשָּׂא־ בָ֖ם אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- hab·bad·dîm ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’ō·ṯām zā·hāḇ wə·niś·śā- ḇām ’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān
verses.literal: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold so that the table may be carried with them
verses.literalPt: Farás, para se levar a mesa com eles, os varais de madeira de acácia e os cobrirás de ouro.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ קְּעָרֹתָ֜יו וְכַפֹּתָ֗יו וּקְשׂוֹתָיו֙ וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā qə·‘ā·rō·ṯāw wə·ḵap·pō·ṯāw ū·qə·śō·w·ṯāw ū·mə·naq·qî·yō·ṯāw ’ă·šer yus·saḵ bā·hên zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: You are also to make the plates and dishes as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings . . . Make them out of pure gold
verses.literalPt: Também farás os seus pratos, e os seus incensários, e os seus copos, e as suas taças em que se hão de oferecer as libações; de ouro puro os farás.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֧ עַֽל־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֛ן לֶ֥חֶם פָּנִ֖ים לְפָנַ֥י תָּמִֽיד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā ‘al- haš·šul·ḥān le·ḥem pā·nîm lə·p̄ā·nay tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times
verses.literalPt: Porás sobre a mesa os pães da proposição diante de mim perpetuamente.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מְנֹרַ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה תֵּעָשֶׂ֤ה הַמְּנוֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā mə·nō·raṯ zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr miq·šāh tê·‘ā·śeh ham·mə·nō·w·rāh yə·rê·ḵāh wə·qā·nāh gə·ḇî·‘e·hā kap̄·tō·re·hā ū·p̄ə·rā·ḥe·hā mim·men·nāh yih·yū
verses.literal: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure hammered gold It shall be made of one piece including its base and shaft its cups and its buds and petals
verses.literalPt: Farás também um candeeiro de ouro puro; de ouro batido se fará o candeeiro, tanto o seu pedestal como a sua haste. Os seus copos, as suas maçãs e as suas açucenas formarão com ele uma só peça.

verses.original: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šiš·šāh qā·nîm yō·ṣə·’îm miṣ·ṣid·de·hā šə·lō·šāh qə·nê mə·nō·rāh miṣ·ṣid·dāh hā·’e·ḥāḏ ū·šə·lō·šāh qə·nê mə·nō·rāh miṣ·ṣid·dāh haš·šê·nî
verses.literal: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand three on one side and three - on the other
verses.literalPt: Seis braços sairão dos seus lados; três braços do candeeiro sairão dum lado dele, e três, do outro.

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בַּקָּנֶ֥ה הָאֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־ הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šāh ḡə·ḇi·‘îm mə·šuq·qā·ḏîm baq·qā·neh hā·’e·ḥāḏ kap̄·tōr wā·p̄e·raḥ ū·šə·lō·šāh ḡə·ḇi·‘îm mə·šuq·qā·ḏîm baq·qā·neh hā·’e·ḥāḏ kap̄·tōr wā·p̄ā·raḥ kên lə·šê·šeṯ haq·qā·nîm hay·yō·ṣə·’îm min- ham·mə·nō·rāh
verses.literal: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch each with buds and petals three - - on the next branch and the same for all six branches that extend from the lampstand
verses.literalPt: Num braço haverá três copos a modo de flores de amêndoas, e juntamente, uma maçã e uma açucena; assim, sucederão com os seis braços que saem do candeeiro.

verses.original: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇam·mə·nō·rāh ’ar·bā·‘āh ḡə·ḇi·‘îm mə·šuq·qā·ḏîm kap̄·tō·re·hā ū·p̄ə·rā·ḥe·hā
verses.literal: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals
verses.literalPt: No mesmo candeeiro haverá quatro copos a modo de flores de amêndoas, com as suas maçãs e com as suas açucenas.

verses.original: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּחַת־ שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֙שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־ הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵap̄·tōr ta·ḥaṯ šə·nê haq·qā·nîm mim·men·nāh wə·ḵap̄·tōr ta·ḥaṯ šə·nê haq·qā·nîm mim·men·nāh wə·ḵap̄·tōr ta·ḥaṯ- šə·nê haq·qā·nîm mim·men·nāh lə·šê·šeṯ haq·qā·nîm hay·yō·ṣə·’îm min- ham·mə·nō·rāh
verses.literal: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand a bud must be under the first pair of branches a bud under the second pair - and a bud under the third pair
verses.literalPt: Haverá uma maçã sob dois braços, formando com a haste uma só peça, outra maçã, sob dois outros, e ainda outra maçã, sob os outros dois braços; e, assim, será com os seis braços que saem do candeeiro.

verses.original: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה יִהְי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: kap̄·tō·rê·hem ū·qə·nō·ṯām mim·men·nāh yih·yū kul·lāh miq·šāh ’a·ḥaṯ zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr
verses.literal: The buds and branches . . . are to be all of one piece with the lampstand hammered out of pure gold
verses.literalPt: As suas maçãs e os seus braços formarão uma só peça com a haste; o todo será de obra batida de ouro puro.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱלָה֙ אֶת־ נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְהֵאִ֖יר עַל־ עֵ֥בֶר פָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- nê·rō·ṯe·hā šiḇ·‘āh wə·he·‘ĕ·lāh ’eṯ- nê·rō·ṯe·hā wə·hê·’îr ‘al- ‘ê·ḇer pā·ne·hā
verses.literal: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it
verses.literalPt: Farás também as suas lâmpadas, em número de sete, as quais se acenderão para alumiar o espaço em frente do candeeiro.

verses.original: וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·qā·ḥe·hā ū·maḥ·tō·ṯe·hā zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr
verses.literal: The wick trimmers and their trays must be of pure gold
verses.literalPt: As suas espevitadeiras e apagadores serão de ouro puro.

verses.original: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: kik·kār zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯāh ’êṯ kāl- hak·kê·lîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: The lampstand and all these utensils shall be made from a talent of pure gold
verses.literalPt: De um talento de ouro puro se fará o candeeiro com todos esses utensílios.

verses.original: וּרְאֵ֖ה וַעֲשֵׂ֑ה בְּתַ֨בְנִיתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה מָרְאֶ֖ה בָּהָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·’êh wa·‘ă·śêh bə·ṯaḇ·nî·ṯām ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh mā·rə·’eh bā·hār
verses.literal: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain
verses.literalPt: Vê que os faças conforme o seu modelo que te foi mostrado no monte.
